records.question: 2014 年销售额最高的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.chart_reading: 5 项中最高是 Australia(53,303.40),其次 China(47,858.51),最低 Spain(21,021.39),最高约为最低的 2.5 倍。
records.sql:
SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?

records.question: Corporate 客户在 2014 年下了多少张订单,平均每张订单金额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_cnt, COUNT(amt) AS orders_with_items, AVG(amt) AS avg_order_sales, SUM(amt) AS total_sales
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, (SELECT SUM(oi.sales) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id) AS amt
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate' AND o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2014-12-31'
)

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(sales) AS median_sales, MAX(n) AS n_nonnull FROM s
WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2)

records.question: 平均利润为负的商品子类有哪些?列出子类和平均利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, AVG(oi.profit) AS avg_profit, COUNT(*) AS items
FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE oi.profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING AVG(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY avg_profit

records.question: 2014 年总利润为负(亏损)的商品子类,按亏损金额从小到大列出子类和总利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS total_profit
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2014-12-31'
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING SUM(i.profit) < 0
ORDER BY total_profit ASC
